title: Mollification of an integrable function by a continuous compactly supported kernel is continuous
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let S ⊆ ℝⁿ be any set (ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure), let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable on S (with respect to Lebesgue measure restricted to S), and let φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be continuous with compact support. Then the function x ↦ ∫_S u(y)φ(x − y) dy is continuous on ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid n)) (φ u : Euclid n → ℝ), IntegrableOn u S → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Continuous (fun x => ∫ y in S, u y * φ (x - y))
